channel.title: MOLOCH.SH · daily briefing
channel.description: The AI-race news that the observatory detects every day, chosen with a fixed rule. Figures from OpenRouter, Artificial Analysis, Epoch AI, Hugging Face and METR, with their source.

item.title: DeepSeek doubles the price of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
item.description: DeepSeek raises the price of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 on OpenRouter: input from $0.15 to $0.3 and output from $0.6 to $1.2 per million tokens. Its blended price on OpenRouter goes from $0.262 to $0.525 per million tokens. Of the 8 models with a similar AA index (±2 points of its 45.1), 1 costs less; the cheapest is Claude Haiku 5.5, at $0.2. It is in the briefing because the lab itself raises its blended price by 100% (threshold: +50% or −33%). Detected on 2026-10-26. Source: OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017/providers). Artificial Analysis data (https://artificialanalysis.ai), published with its permission.

item.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro becomes the best open-weight model on the AA index
item.description: Kimi K3.1 Pro becomes the best open-weight model in the catalogue on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3: 55.1 points, 8.8 more than MiMo-V2.6-Pro (46.3). Its weights have been announced by the lab, but cannot be downloaded yet. The gap between the best closed and the best open-weight model on the AA index stands at 2.5 points (11.3 the day before). It does not equate to months of lag. It is in the briefing because the best open-weight model changes with the same AA index version and a margin of 8.8 points (minimum 1). Detected on 2026-10-24. Source: Artificial Analysis (https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/kimi-k3-1-pro). Artificial Analysis data (https://artificialanalysis.ai), published with its permission.

item.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro (Moonshot AI) arrives on OpenRouter: rank 3 on the AA index
item.description: Kimi K3.1 Pro (Moonshot AI) appears in the OpenRouter catalogue. AA index 55.1: 8.8 points above the previous best open-weight model (MiMo-V2.6-Pro). Rank 3 of 142. Blended price $4 per million tokens. It is in the briefing because it is a new model and enters the top 20 of the AA index (rank 3 of 142). Published on 2026-10-23; detected on 2026-10-24. Source: OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai/moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro). Artificial Analysis data (https://artificialanalysis.ai), published with its permission.

item.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 becomes the most used model on OpenRouter
item.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 becomes the most used model on OpenRouter over the last 7 days (14.9% of tokens), ahead of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. 14.9% of OpenRouter’s tokens from 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-23; before, the first was deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20260910. This is usage on OpenRouter, not across the whole market. It is in the briefing because the most used model on OpenRouter over the last 7 days changes. Published on 2026-10-23; detected on 2026-10-24. Source: OpenRouter · usage (https://openrouter.ai/rankings).

item.title: Minimax starts charging for MiniMax M3.1 Flash on OpenRouter
item.description: Minimax starts charging for MiniMax M3.1 Flash on OpenRouter: $0.15 input and $0.6 output per million tokens. Until now it was free. Its blended price on OpenRouter goes from free to $0.262 per million tokens. Of the 10 models with a similar AA index (±2 points of its 42.7), 3 cost less; the cheapest is Ling 3.1 Flash, at $0.112. It is in the briefing because the lab itself starts charging for it on OpenRouter, where it was free. Detected on 2026-10-23. Source: OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai/minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash/providers). Artificial Analysis data (https://artificialanalysis.ai), published with its permission.
